metaTitle: Custom Full Color Emery Boards | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom full color emery boards with your logo. Perfect for salons and events. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Full color emery boards let you print your logo, design, or photo directly on the nail file surface using high-resolution sublimation or offset printing. Unlike single-color foil stamping, full color gives you photographic detail and unlimited color gradients. This makes them ideal for salon giveaways, spa welcome kits, or event swag where visual impact matters. Choose from standard 3.5" keyring files or 7" salon boards with EVA pouches for a polished takeaway.
heroAltText: Custom full color emery boards with printed logo design on nail files for salon or event giveaways.
